messages.author: 084d0345d2a3706f
messages.subject: Re: Error deploying app
parts:
So it looks like i figured it out.  I was saving my workspaces (.Rdata files) in the same directory which the deploy runs on.  Since these files had grown quite large it looks like it started interfering with the deployment process.  Eventhough when these .Rdata files were much smaller in previous versions of my app, it did not affect the deployment process. My workaround was simply to move all these .Rdata files somewhere else and re-run deployApp().  Now it works fine

-Justin
